title: AI Video Editing Tools Surge in Q4 Funding
executive_summary: Three startups in AI video editing raised $180M combined. The market is validating autonomous editing as a category. For creators, this means cheaper, more powerful tools arriving in 6 months.
key_insight: The autonomous editing category just got validated by $180M in VC -- commoditization in 6-12 months.
